rule: VAMILY rule 416 (Paolo 11/6, ask line 468): THE BIG INTERIORS, the first one: a casino floor
his_words: I don't think I'd want the interiors to be like human sized as the characters are for real, I still want like this is a block and turf war, I always want that feeling... some fights could be inside too
how_to_mod: A layout is 15 strings of 20 characters, one a board row, north at the top; each character is a tile, read in the legend. The camera sees the south face of things, so a wall of screens or the cage goes on a north wall facing south. Both lines must stand on open floor: his at columns 4 and 5, theirs at column 11, rows 3 to 11. A layout may be mirrored east to west by the dice ('flip').

..say: the gaming floor's carpet, worn to the backing in the aisles

S.say: a bank of dead slot machines: cover a man crouches behind

T.say: a table of the pit: low cover

P.say: a column: nobody walks through it

C.say: the cashier's cage: a counter under steel bars, no way through but its door

v.say: the strong room behind the cage: its own floor, its one door

B.say: the centre bar: a counter a man takes cover at

K.say: the sportsbook's wall of dead screens, one frozen on the last odds

k.say: the sportsbook's seats at their desk: low cover

H.say: the lounge stage: one step up, high ground

#.say: a wall, the roof and the floors above it cut away

g.say: the front doors, two leaves gone: the way in from the porte-cochere
